items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Shake dancer? [INTERVIEWEE] ...nothing but a strip. She wasn’t nothin’ but a striptease dancer.

ctx.x: Well, not a chorus line. They’d have one woman who was supposed to be an interpretive dancer, but she was...
...nothing but a strip. She wasn’t nothin’ but a striptease dancer.
